video.title: Mountain Weather Update 11/1, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description: Snow continues through 11/2.  Temps are initially warm but then freezing levels drop to lower elevations this afternoon/tonight into 11/2.  Moderate to heavy snow accumulation at mid-mountain and higher.  Tiny, fast storm system with light snow accumulation 11/4-11/5.  Potentially larger storm system 11/11-11/14.
